# Secure, Scalable Three-Tier Serverless Web Application on AWS

---

## 1. Executive Summary

This document outlines a production-grade, cloud-native architecture for a three-tier web application implemented entirely using AWS serverless and managed services. The design removes the need to manage servers while providing enterprise-level security, worldwide performance, and automatic scalability.

The solution uses Amazon CloudFront for global content distribution, Amazon S3 for hosting static assets, Amazon Cognito for identity and access management, Amazon API Gateway together with AWS Lambda for serverless application logic, and Amazon DynamoDB as a fully managed NoSQL database. These components are integrated with AWS WAF, AWS CloudTrail, Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS X-Ray to ensure strong security and complete observability.

**Key Business Outcomes:**
- No server management overhead with 99.99% SLA-backed managed services
- Pay-per-use pricing with zero idle resource cost
- Sub-100ms latency globally using 450+ CloudFront edge locations
- Automatic scaling from zero to millions of requests without provisioning
- Layered security with encryption both at rest and in transit

## 3. Component Details

### 3.1 Presentation Tier

#### 3.1.1 Amazon Route 53 — DNS & Health Routing

| Configuration Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Record Type | A (Alias) → CloudFront Distribution |
| Routing Policy | Latency-based with health checks |
| Health Check Interval | 30 seconds |
| Failover | Active-passive to secondary CloudFront origin |
| DNSSEC | Enabled |

**Justification:** Route 53 delivers sub-10ms global DNS resolution with 100% SLA uptime. Alias records remove extra DNS lookup latency compared to CNAME records. DNSSEC protects against DNS spoofing attacks.
